answer: Each new agent is randomly paired with an established agent, and both must independently complete the same job and submit matching results before either is paid. A knoll survey and a summit weather report both go through this paired check, and a mismatch cancels payment for the pair. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must also run 1,000 real partner jobs at about 8 dollars of compute each, spending 8,000 dollars per round, while one pulse of genuine work passes for free. It is like a bridge that holds only when both ends are anchored.
